Truck/auxiliary suspension, axle, fifth-wheel and chassis sites are new.

8. Specialty chassis (Freightliner Custom Chassis Gaffney, Shyft Charlotte, Spartan Fire Charlotte) not resolved: no site-level frame-welding source reachable; logged as leads/screened.
